title: 第2012章 斩修罗闻黑罗第2011章 重创修罗
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
天雷仙界。
历经颠沛流离，总算寻到安身之所。
可还未多久，便被打上门来。
那是一只恐怖的青袍妖兽，凶焰滔天，放眼整个天雷仙界，竟无一是其对手。
天雷界灵本以为这就够惨的了，没想到那青袍妖兽斩尽天雷鹏一族后，又有一只真仙后期大妖紧随而至。
两者大战，打的那是天地失色，日月无光，连天雷仙界都快磨灭了。
“我怎么也是一座七阶中品仙界，价值不菲，你们注意点啊。”
天雷界灵看着远处混战的青红灵光，心中一阵无力。
实际上，即使这儿是在天雷仙界内，它却看不清楚里面的情况，只能以灵光勉强猜测。
此时的青色灵光已经占据了九成九，磨灭另一只妖兽，想来用不了太长时间了吧？
“应该快了，应该快了，再打下去，我就实在坚持不住了。”
天雷界灵正嘀咕间，却听那轰鸣忽止，就连天地灵气也缓缓沉寂下来，顿时一愣。
极目望去，只见烟尘与灵光渐渐散开。
这是……结束了？！
然而并没有——
“这修罗，还在玩这些小把戏。”
顾安眯着双眼，眸光落在那逸散的血光中，嗤笑一声，袖袍将其全部荡碎。
果不其然，有一点血光坚持了下来。
一把抓住！
见最后的手段也被废去，迷你的修罗真仙灵影汇聚，连连讨饶，“古冥，古冥，咱们还交易过呢，我还卖给你不少宝物呢，你怎么能过河拆桥！”

“留着我，留我一命，我愿交出一身宝物，我愿交出黑罗仙界的位置，我愿奉你……”
话还没有说完，便被顾安捏碎。
“你分神逃出薪火殿堂，暴露本仙真颜之时，可没有这等诚心，现在想要悔过，未免也太晚了。”
嗤笑声与那散碎的血光，一同飘飘扬扬落下。
纵横虚空的一代真仙，彻底陨落。
看着这曾经令自己忌惮不已的修罗真仙死在手中，顾安也是不胜唏嘘，“虽然是第一次见面，但咱们结仇已久，你有今天，也是罪有应得。”
但心中更多的是振奋。
昔日不敢见面的强敌，今日已经陨落在手中。
自己的脚步从未停止，过去是，现在是，未来也是！
甚至并未浪费太多时间，仅仅七年而已。
七年时间，还是因为修罗真仙底牌层出不穷，一直赖着不死，方才拖延了那么久的时间。
而其实力，在真仙后期中也说不得弱。
更重要的是，自己压根就没受什么伤。
一念至此，顾安心情大好，连真颜被暴露出去的苦恼，也消散了许多，“说到底，也没几只妖兽见过我的真颜，麻烦不大。”
只不过，自己在血源仙界的消息被泄露出去，可能会有些麻烦。
更麻烦的是，黑罗仙界估摸着已经警觉起来了。
甚至说不定已经跑了。
“该死的修罗！”
想到此处，顾安双眼微眯，心中不无郁闷。
content_en:
Heavenly Thunder Immortal Realm.
After many ups and downs, he finally found a place to settle down.
But not long after, he was knocked on the door.
It was a terrifying green-robed demonic beast, with fierce flames raging into the sky. Looking at the entire Tianlei Immortal Realm, no one could be its opponent.
The Tianlei World Spirit originally thought that this was miserable enough, but he didn't expect that after the green-robed monster killed the Tianlei Peng clan, another great demon in the late stage of True Immortal followed closely behind.
The battle between the two was such that the heaven and earth were eclipsed, the sun and the moon were dimmed, and even the Heavenly Thunder Immortal Realm was almost wiped out.
"I am also a seventh-level mid-level immortal world, and it is worth a lot of money. Please be careful."
The Heavenly Thunder World Spirit looked at the blue-red spiritual light fighting in the distance and felt helpless in its heart.
In fact, even though it was within the Heavenly Thunder Immortal Realm, it could not clearly see what was going on inside and could only barely guess with its aura.
At this time, the cyan aura has occupied 99%, and it won't take too long to destroy another monster, right?
"It should be fast, it should be fast. If I keep fighting, I really can't hold on anymore."
The Heavenly Thunder World Spirit was muttering, but it suddenly stopped when it heard the roar, and even the spiritual energy of heaven and earth slowly became silent, and was suddenly stunned.
Looking as far as the eye could see, the smoke and aura gradually dispersed.
Is this... the end? !
However, there was no——
"This Shura is still playing these little tricks."
Gu An squinted his eyes, his eyes fell on the scattered blood, he sneered, and his sleeves and robes were completely shattered.
Sure enough, a little bit of blood persisted.
Grab it!
Seeing that the last resort was discarded, the miniature Shura True Immortal spirits gathered together and begged for mercy, "Gu Ming, Gu Ming, we have even traded, and I sold you a lot of treasures. How can you cross the river and burn the bridge!"
"Keep me, keep me alive, I am willing to hand over all my treasures, I am willing to hand over my position in the Black Luo Immortal World, I am willing to serve you..."
Before he finished speaking, he was crushed by Gu An.
"When you escaped from the Xinhuo Palace and exposed my true face, you were not so sincere. It's too late to repent now."
The scoffing laughter and the scattered blood flew down together.
The generation of true immortals who roamed the void completely fell.
Seeing the death of the Shura Immortal who had once made him so fearful, Gu An was deeply saddened, "Although this is the first time we have met, we have been enemies for a long time. You deserve what you have today."
But my heart is more exciting.
The powerful enemy that I dared not meet in the past has fallen into my hands today.
My steps have never stopped, in the past, now, and in the future!
Not even that much time was wasted, just seven years.
In the past seven years, it had been delayed for so long because of the endless trump cards of Shura Immortal, who had been hanging on.
And its strength cannot be said to be weak even in the late stage of True Immortal.
More importantly, he was not injured at all.
After thinking about this, Gu An was in a good mood, and even the distress of having his true face exposed dissipated a lot, "After all, not many monsters have seen my true face, so it won't be a big trouble."
However, if the news that he is in the Bloodborne Immortal Realm is leaked, there may be some trouble.
What's even more troublesome is that the Black Luo Immortal Realm is probably on alert.
He might even have run away.
"Damn Shura!"
Thinking of this, Gu An narrowed his eyes slightly and felt depressed.
